entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to make a return. Order number is VF88602.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can definitely help you with that. Let me just pull up your order... VF88602. How are you doing today?
I'm busy. Look, can I return this helmet or not? It's a simple question.
Yes, of course. I see the order right here. It shows delivery was 12 days ago. Just for our records, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
There's no issue. The color is fine, it's not a safety thing, I just don't need it. The box is unopened. I just need a return label.

Understood. Thank you for clarifying. Since the helmet is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return policy. And since the box is unopened, that makes it even easier. I'm approving this return for you right now.
Great. So you're sending the label?
Yes. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
